scope: Original 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12, complete standard 2–4-player multiplayer with required standard scoring two-player Rival and optional standard base-box CHOAM (20 contracts); separate 10 Ix contracts identified only. Relevant general/Uprising Jan 13 2025 FAQ applied. Solo, optional Rival variants, six-player and cross-game/later-product additions excluded.

checked_claims.claim: Scope, compatibility sorting, and exclusion of optional Rival behavior
checked_claims.details: Standard 2–4-player scope includes scoring Rival; Streamlined-only leaders are excluded. Ten Ix contracts are additional to the 20 standard contracts.
Counts, starting-card identities, token supply and 4+4 CHOAM card inclusion agree.

checked_claims.claim: Face-down Conflict deck composition and randomization
checked_claims.details: All four III shuffled, five of nine II shuffled, one of three I shuffled; unused cards returned unseen; Row and Objective face-up states agree.

checked_claims.claim: Leader selection, player setup and bank
checked_claims.details: Correct initial score by count, 3 garrison/9 supply troops, 2 active Agents, Swordmaster aside, 1 water, Spy supply and Hooks bank. Resources and worms are not component-limited.
Five-card draw, revealed Conflict, optional defensive supply troop, Agent/Reveal choices, clockwise turns and special Rival continuation are correctly reconciled.

checked_claims.claim: Agent entry, legal card icons and effect order
checked_claims.details: Matching normal icon or connected Spy Agent icon required; occupancy exceptions do not waive access or costs; entry paid before destination/card effects; legal pre-entry Plot resource gains can pay entry.
Three steps, any Reveal-effect order, acquisition timing, strength setting and cleanup agree.

checked_claims.claim: Combat window, strength and paid ranks
checked_claims.details: Consecutive passing, reentry after an earlier pass, immediate strength adjustments, 0-strength exclusion, first/second in 2–3-player and third in 4-player all agree.

checked_claims.claim: Winner card destination, match order and postcombat destinations
checked_claims.details: Rewards precede taking won Conflict face up into supply; mandatory match afterward; troops to supply, worms to bank and track reset.
Three standard Maker spaces, unoccupied bonus-spice accrual, Recall trigger, human-only First Player alternation in 2P and Agent destinations agree.
Troops from supply to garrison; current-turn recruits plus at most two older garrison units at Combat spaces; 2 troop/3 worm/1 sword strength and no-unit zero strength.

checked_claims.claim: Sandworm legality, Hooks and Shield Wall
checked_claims.details: Summoning deploys directly; Hooks only when specified and never spent; three protected Conflicts until permanent removal; doubling excludes control and battle icons and permits a second paid reward.

checked_claims.claim: Battle icons, trashing, influence and scoring
checked_claims.details: Mandatory same-icon pair, Endgame wild matching, acquire destination, optional trash exceptions and reserve return, 2-Influence VP, separate 4-Influence bonus/Alliance rewards and loss rules are supported.

checked_claims.claim: Spy placement, recall timing and alternatives
checked_claims.details: Optional placement/recall, empty post, supply exhaustion, icon-limited placement, Infiltrate other players only, Gather Intelligence before effects, two distinct Spies for distinct effects, and no Spy recall for Spy Agent access agree.

checked_claims.claim: Control, Faction requirements and payment arrows
checked_claims.details: Controller bonus includes own visits; defensive troop originates in supply; 2-Influence requirements do not make those spaces Faction spaces; costs once except doubled Conflict rewards.

checked_claims.claim: Intrigue, drawing, discard, in-play and other icons
checked_claims.details: Correct Intrigue privacy/types/discard, 4-card theft threshold, deck draw, hand discard, ties, Fremen Bond, other-Agent recall, retreat and Swordmaster behavior.
Feyd setup/end stop, Jessica starting side, upward reaches/passes 2, immediate Shaddam restriction and Spacing Guild Favor cleanup exception all agree.

checked_claims.claim: CHOAM initial count and Shaddam reservation
source_references: original Shaddam Leader image: Sardaukar Commander and Emperor of the Known Universe panels
checked_claims.details: 20 standard contracts; absent Shaddam two offers/18 bank, with him two reserved and two offers/16 bank. Original card independently confirms reservation, exclusivity, either 1 Solari + recruit or pay 3 Solari for 1 chosen Influence, and turn-long deployment restriction.

checked_claims.claim: Contracts acquisition, completion and compatibility set
checked_claims.details: Contract fallback, replacement, four completion types, Harvest aggregate spice, possession before placement, completed face-down supply destination and Ix set sorting agree.

checked_claims.claim: Rival setup, sequencing and legal Hagal processing
checked_claims.details: Scoring shared opponent, printed thresholds/abilities, Objective assignment, normal no-solo setup, two-human First Player rotation, unoccupied conditional destination, reshuffle and Spy-only continuation are correct.

checked_claims.claim: Rival Signet/Scheme separation, Spy placement and troops
checked_claims.details: Signet Ring invokes its own printed ability; third supply Spy invokes Scheme and recalls other two; specified/default post priorities and same-turn Scheme recruitment deployment agree.

checked_claims.claim: Rival resource conversion, Maker behavior, Hooks and Wall
source_references: supplements PDF page 5 Buying Victory Points diagram
checked_claims.details: All four resources count toward threshold; spend order Solari/spice/Intrigue/water, leftovers, then 7 Solari/7 spice/3 Intrigues/3 water per VP confirmed visually. Bonus spice always collected, legal worms preferred, otherwise base spice. Wall removal requires Rival Hooks.

One bottom-swords Hagal bonus for deployed Rival in turn order before humans play Combat Intrigues; ordinary rewards, doubling, battle icons, control and defense, least-Influence with leftmost priority, optional affordable Conflict VP and contract-to-2-Solari fallback agree.

Mandatory effects/contract completion, once-only costs, Alliance transfer, Shaddam, Spy limits, timing for drawn cards, Intrigue replenishment, recruited troops, victory rewards, final tiebreak, Jessica/False Orders/Manipulate/Litany all accurately summarized.
Condensed reference agrees with full rules; exceptions elaborated above remain available.
